en.k3d: 8 open-water swims · 1 SUP · 1 walk · no gym (vacation)
en.eNote: No meals logged for Jul 31 – Aug 6 (last intake log: Jun 14), so the energy and burn charts assume the 2,000 kcal plan. Garmin active burn averaged ~534 kcal/day, peaking 1,121 on Tuesday's four-swim day and 754 on Monday's double. Saturday (295 kcal) was the only full rest day; Thursday (Aug 6) is just starting at 1 kcal.
en.bNote: Net exercise = Garmin active calories; standing BMR 2,414 (today's Garmin BMR reads 853 because the day is incomplete). Intake assumes 2,000 kcal all seven days (none logged after Jun 14), so the implied balance ≈ −948 kcal/day is exercise-driven, not measured. Thursday (Aug 6) just starting.
en.wNote: Bridge shows the last logged meals (Jun 12–14) — no intake was logged for the displayed week. Negative balance = deficit.
en.i1t: Ten sessions, five active days — all of it in open water
en.i1: 10 sessions across 5 active days, 3h 15m and ~2,244 active kcal. Eight open-water swims totalling 5,495 m, one SUP paddle of 416 m, and one 808 m walk in Prozor. No gym and no logged tonnage — Hevy has recorded nothing since Jul 30, which matches a vacation week rather than a missed log. Tuesday was the biggest day: four swims back to back, 69 minutes in the water, 2,210 m and 1,121 active kcal, the window high. Saturday was the only full rest day; today has not started.
en.i2t: Swim volume is 2.5× the pre-vacation week
en.i2: 5,495 m of open water across five days against 2,225 m of pool work in the Jul 24–30 window — two and a half times the volume with no strength work at all. The shape is short and repeated rather than long: eight swims averaging 687 m and 22 minutes, none over 38 minutes, at avg HR 104–129. Tuesday's four-swim block (596 / 420 / 601 / 593 m) is the pattern — repeat efforts at the lowest intensity of the week, closer to sustained aerobic exposure than to intervals. Friday's Primošten swim holds the window's HR high at 174 max against a 126 average; for open water that gap is more likely a contact artifact than a real effort spike.
en.i3t: Two nights untracked — watch off the wrist, not a sync fault
en.i3: The Mon 3 and Tue 4 evenings have no sleep record. Body Battery recharged only 9 and 3 points on those mornings against 43 to 59 on tracked nights, and no HRV was written either, so the watch was off the wrist overnight. Everything else kept flowing: Garmin daily, stress, respiration and epoch data are complete through this morning, and last night's sleep landed normally. The sleep chart shows the seven most recent recorded nights, Tue 28 to Wed 5, and skips the two gaps.
en.i4t: Recovery: longest night of the window, thinnest deep sleep
en.i4: Last night ran 8h 32m — the window's longest and 1h 37m over the 6h 55m average — but scored 77, four under the previous recorded night. Composition is why: 50 minutes deep against 342 light and 120 REM, with 36 minutes awake. Deep has been under an hour on four of the last five recorded nights (48, 48, 61, 50) after 107 and 98 mid-window. HRV 36 and RHR 55 both sit level with the seven-night average, and average stress was 22, the calmest reading of the window. Readiness 73, moderate.
en.rec: Nothing here needs holding back. Five active days, all aerobic, nothing above avg HR 129, and the two rest days fell where they were useful. The one thing worth changing is the shape of the swimming: eight swims averaging 687 m and 22 minutes is a lot of repeated short efforts and very little continuous time. If you want this week to carry into the return to the gym, make one of the next three a single continuous 1,500–2,000 m instead of four 600s — same volume, far more aerobic value. Watch RHR: 59 and 60 on Tue 4 and Wed 5 are the window's two highest against 53 mid-window, and both landed on the untracked nights, which is consistent with hot nights and broken sleep rather than the swim load, which stayed low-intensity throughout. Last night's 55 already walked it back. Wear the watch tonight so the next two nights go back on the record. Next: keep the daily swim, put one long continuous effort in, and leave the gym alone until you are home.

hr.k3d: 8 plivanja na moru · 1 SUP · 1 šetnja · bez teretane (godišnji)
hr.eNote: Nema zabilježenih obroka za 31.7. – 6.8. (zadnji unos: 14.6.), pa grafovi energije i potrošnje pretpostavljaju planskih 2.000 kcal. Garmin aktivna potrošnja prosj. ~534 kcal/dan, vrhunac 1.121 na utorkovom danu s četiri plivanja i 754 na ponedjeljkovom dvostrukom. Subota (295 kcal) bila je jedini potpuni dan odmora; četvrtak (6.8.) tek počinje s 1 kcal.
hr.bNote: Neto trening = Garmin aktivne kalorije; standardni BMR 2.414 (današnji Garminov BMR pokazuje 853 jer dan nije završen). Unos pretpostavlja 2.000 kcal svih sedam dana (ništa zabilježeno nakon 14.6.), pa je implicirana bilanca ≈ −948 kcal/dan posljedica treninga, ne mjerena. Četvrtak (6.8.) tek počinje.
hr.wNote: Most prikazuje zadnje zabilježene obroke (12.–14.6.) — za prikazani tjedan nema unosa. Negativna bilanca = deficit.
hr.i1t: Deset treninga, pet aktivnih dana — sve na otvorenom moru
hr.i1: 10 treninga kroz 5 aktivnih dana, 3h 15m i ~2.244 aktivnih kcal. Osam plivanja na moru ukupno 5.495 m, jedno veslanje na SUP-u od 416 m i jedna šetnja od 808 m u Prozoru. Bez teretane i bez zabilježene tonaže — Hevy nema ništa od 30.7., što odgovara tjednu godišnjeg, a ne propuštenom zapisu. Utorak je bio najveći dan: četiri plivanja zaredom, 69 minuta u vodi, 2.210 m i 1.121 aktivna kcal, najviše u prozoru. Subota je bila jedini potpuni dan odmora; danas još nije počelo.
hr.i2t: Volumen plivanja 2,5× veći nego tjedan prije godišnjeg
hr.i2: 5.495 m otvorenog mora kroz pet dana naspram 2.225 m bazena u prozoru 24.–30.7. — dva i pol puta više volumena, i to bez ijednog treninga snage. Oblik je kratak i ponavljan, a ne dug: osam plivanja u prosjeku 687 m i 22 minute, nijedno preko 38 minuta, uz prosječni puls 104–129. Utorkov blok od četiri plivanja (596 / 420 / 601 / 593 m) je obrazac — ponovljeni napori najnižeg intenziteta u tjednu, bliže trajnoj aerobnoj izloženosti nego intervalima. Petkovo plivanje u Primoštenu drži maksimum prozora sa 174 naspram prosjeka 126; za otvoreno more ta je razlika vjerojatnije artefakt kontakta nego stvarni skok napora.
hr.i3t: Dvije noći bez zapisa — sat nije bio na ruci, nije greška sinkronizacije
hr.i3: Večeri pon 3. i uto 4. nemaju zapis sna. Body Battery se tih jutara napunio samo 9 i 3 boda naspram 43 do 59 na zabilježenim noćima, a ni HRV nije zapisan, pa sat noću nije bio na ruci. Sve ostalo je teklo normalno: Garminovi dnevni podaci, stres, disanje i epoch podaci potpuni su do jutros, a sinoćnji san stigao je uredno. Graf sna prikazuje sedam najnovijih zabilježenih noći, od Uto 28 do Sri 5, i preskače dvije rupe.
hr.i4t: Oporavak: najdulja noć u prozoru, najtanji duboki san
hr.i4: Sinoć je noć trajala 8h 32m — najdulja u prozoru i 1h 37m iznad prosjeka od 6h 55m — ali je ocijenjena sa 77, četiri niže od prethodne zabilježene noći. Razlog je sastav: 50 minuta dubokog sna naspram 342 lakog i 120 REM-a, uz 36 minuta budnosti. Duboki san bio je ispod sat vremena u četiri od zadnjih pet zabilježenih noći (48, 48, 61, 50), nakon 107 i 98 sredinom prozora. HRV 36 i RHR 55 oba su na razini prosjeka sedam noći, a prosječni stres bio je 22, najmirnije očitanje u prozoru. Spremnost 73, umjerena.
hr.rec: Ovdje ništa ne treba kočiti. Pet aktivnih dana, sve aerobno, ništa iznad prosječnog pulsa 129, a dva dana odmora pala su tamo gdje su koristila. Jedino što vrijedi promijeniti je oblik plivanja: osam plivanja u prosjeku 687 m i 22 minute puno je ponovljenih kratkih napora i vrlo malo neprekidnog vremena. Ako želiš da se ovaj tjedan prenese na povratak u teretanu, neka jedno od sljedeća tri bude jedno neprekidno plivanje od 1.500–2.000 m umjesto četiri po 600 — isti volumen, znatno veća aerobna vrijednost. Prati RHR: 59 i 60 u uto 4. i sri 5. dva su najviša u prozoru naspram 53 sredinom tjedna, i oba su pala na noći bez zapisa, što više odgovara vrućim noćima i isprekidanom snu nego opterećenju od plivanja, koje je cijelo vrijeme ostalo niskog intenziteta. Sinoćnjih 55 to je već vratilo natrag. Stavi sat večeras da sljedeće dvije noći uđu u zapis. Sljedeće: zadrži dnevno plivanje, ubaci jedan dugi neprekidni napor i pusti teretanu na miru do povratka.
